description: This file is a shell script that performs unit tests for the Git submodule mechanism, particularly testing the 'is-active' functionality of submodules using a custom test tool. It sets up a Git environment, manipulates submodule configurations, and verifies behavior under various configurations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success; runs given commands and marks success or failure.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to be run after the test completes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail; reports if it does not.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with a message in a specified repository or directory.

methods.name: git config
methods.description: Configures Git settings, including submodule configurations.

methods.name: git submodule add
methods.description: Adds a submodule to the repository.

methods.name: test-tool
methods.description: Custom tool used within tests to check submodule properties, specifically 'is-active'.
